captions.detailed: A standard handheld zoom camera lens rendered in a matte black finish. It features a main outer barrel, a ribbed zoom ring, a ribbed focus ring, and an inner telescoping barrel section. The zoom and focus rings are designed to rotate continuously around the main optical axis, while the inner barrel section translates linearly along the optical axis to extend or retract the lens.
captions.instruction: Generate a standard handheld zoom camera lens with a matte black outer barrel, a ribbed zoom ring, a ribbed focus ring, and a telescoping inner barrel. The zoom and focus rings should have continuous rotational joints about the lens axis, and the inner barrel should have a prismatic joint allowing linear translation along the optical axis.
captions.factory: Construct the main outer barrel, zoom ring, focus ring, and inner barrel as coaxial cylinders. Apply linear patterns or grooved profiles to the outer faces of the zoom and focus rings to create the grip ribs. Define continuous joints for the zoom ring and focus ring about the central Z-axis, and define a prismatic joint for the inner barrel along the Z-axis with appropriate motion limits.
